description: Set the SSH authorized public keys on a running sandbox, enabling direct SSH access for the given keys.

public_keys.description: SSH public keys (ssh-ed25519 …, ssh-rsa …) to authorize. Replaces the current set.

session_id.description: Sandbox session id (UUID), from tenki_create_sandbox or tenki_list_sandboxes.

name: tenki_update_ssh_keys
